resources.string: This Direct failure can be reassessed for ② Stream. Inspect again and explicitly choose a fresh supported Stream source. The failed task stays unchanged; no Stream or recording capability is assumed.
② New Stream attempt after Direct failure. Choose a variant and destination to confirm. The failed task stays unchanged. Preparation does not guarantee a playable saved video.
This Stream reassessment is no longer available. No alternative task was started. Inspect again for a new explicit selection.

The new Stream task creation result could not be confirmed. Do not submit it again. Reopen the app and check task recovery; saving will not start automatically. Dismissing this message does not remove a task that may have been created.
